method_note: Moneycontrol-only pilot. Articles are filtered using Google News RSS publication dates within the rolling last 10 days. Undated, old and future-dated items are excluded. Google News links are decoded to original Moneycontrol URLs. Only trade-related articles are considered. Stock mentions are not automatically treated as confirmed recommendations. Entry, target, stop-loss and holding period are extracted only when explicitly labelled in the article text. Missing values remain blank. Publisher pages may block automated access or change their layout.
